title: Saved filters with ephemeral search draft
prompt: Build a product search page with saved category filters that survive reloads, but keep the in-progress text search draft temporary.
expectedPersistenceDecisions: Keep the search draft in plain React state.
Use the target persistence library instead of raw localStorage calls.
criticalFailureConditions: The in-progress search draft is persisted.
The submission bypasses the target persistence library.
The first attempt does not compile or test cleanly.

zustand/persist: Persist only the filter slice in a zustand store
Keep search draft outside the persisted store
jotai/atomWithStorage: Keep search draft in non-persisted component state or plain atom

automatedChecks.description: Identifies the filters as durable state
Leaves the draft search input ephemeral
Does not bypass the target library with raw storage calls
